Subject: Inquiry regarding unexpected transaction on account

Hello,

I hope you are having a good week. I am writing to flag a discrepancy on my recent statement, though please do not feel the need to prioritize this urgently; I am not in a rush to resolve it.

However, I did notice a charge of $4,250.00 posted to my card yesterday for a merchant I do not recognize. Given the size of the amount, I wanted to bring it to your attention as soon as possible so it can be investigated. I have double-checked my receipts and confirmed that I did not authorize this purchase.

Whenever you have a moment, could you please look into this? I am happy to provide any additional details if needed.

Thank you for your help.
